title: InstructScene: Instruction-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis with Semantic Graph Prior

layout.note: A top row of three titled stages (instruction bubble with a person icon, semantic graph, 3D render) joined by two thick arrows with a robot-head and a robot-arm icon above them and a verb below; a lower strip holds the Object Feature Codebook swatch grid, a big grey curved arrow and a dashed gold zoom box tied by a wedge to one graph node.

lesson: Thread one real instruction through every stage and keep one colour per object from the underlined phrase to the graph node, then open a single node with a dashed wedge into the features it is built from; a verb and a small icon on each thick arrow name the stages without extra boxes.
